title: The Effects of GLA (5 mcg) on Human Volunteers
brief_summary: This protocol is for a phase 1, randomized, single-blinded study to evaluate the safety and tolerability of a single 5 mcg dose of GLA-SE administered intramuscularly and GLA-AF administered subcutaneously. The second focus will be to detail the global immune response by measuring systemic cytokines, chemokines, and global gene regulation. The third focus will be to investigate the effects of GLA on the peripheral blood immune cells including monocytes and dendritic cells. The results of this trial will generate supportive human data to use GLA as an adjuvant in a dendritic cell-targeted vaccine strategy.
